1.title: Small plane crashes near regional airport in Florida
1.summary: The National Transportation Safety Board, the agency investigating the crash, has identified the plane as a Mooney M20F aircraft, a four-seater propeller plane.

2.title: 5 Races to Watch This Fall for Answers to the Biggest Midterm Questions
2.summary: From Iowa to Michigan to Texas, key contests will offer clues about voters’ views of President Trump, progressive ideas, the war with Iran and more.

3.title: Why Amy Klobuchar Wants to Run a State Beleaguered by Trump
3.summary: The senator opted to run for governor, having concluded that many Minnesotans lost faith in state government under fellow Democrats. But some wonder: Would she be a fighter in the role, or a conciliator?

4.title: Canada’s Retaliatory Tariffs Set to Take Effect as Trump Threatens to Escalate
4.summary: New Canadian levies of up to 50 percent are expected to begin Tuesday, even as Washington warns of a new round of American tariffs.

5.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
5.summary: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties.

6.title: Israel Launches Deadly Strikes in Lebanon as Military Campaign Intensifies
6.summary: The bombardment killed 11 people, Lebanese officials said, after days of attacks that have spurred worries that Israel is looking to push deeper into Lebanese territory.
